Drones struck the Russian corvette Merkury at Benghazi, Libya, on 22 November in an attack Ukraine claims; satellite imagery shows it capsized, and Libya's eastern government asked for a UN investigation.
Russia summoned Estonia's chargé d'affaires on 23 November over the 1 December border closure, warning of "the brink of an open war".
Iran said on 23 November it will use "all available means" against the US blockade and could reopen Hormuz within two days if hostilities, the blockade and sanctions end.
Iran summoned Qatar's envoy on 23 November over a Qatar-Germany statement urging it to stop arming the Houthis and keep the Strait open.
NATO said it will defend itself in space after German media reported Russia may launch a nuclear-armed satellite as soon as December; the Kremlin dismissed the report.

Two Russian cruise missiles and a drone crashed in south-eastern Poland on 20 November during a mass attack on Ukraine; Prime Minister Tusk called it an intentional provocation, and NATO scrambled jets.
Drones hit homes and a UN building in Khartoum on 22 November; Sudan's army says they were launched from Ethiopia, which denies it.
Talks on an Israeli unity government between Netanyahu's Likud and Eisenkot's Yashar ended without a deal on 22 November.
